Chapter 6604: Protect

Chapter 6604: Protect

Calamities was a famous overlord alongside Supreme Black Ancestor, Li Xingchen, and First Vine. He stood on the side of Life and Death Heaven.

However, Calamities was more reclusive and only showed up for the major wars. Some said this was due to his background, being an ancestor of Arrogance Enterprise.

This was the richest and oldest business in Three Immortals, potentially older than any other lineage. Some said Calamities was the founder of Arrogance Enterprise.

However, others only considered him to be an ancient ancestor there. Nevertheless, he played a big part in its success.

Information regarding him was limited. Few knew about his origin and even appearance. The accompanying tribulations could explain his enigmatic nature. No one wanted to get close.

He seemed to be a source of tribulations. Being near him might invoke a personal tribulation. Therefore, even immortals kept a distance.

No one understood why he had so many tribulations, but this was the reason for his title, Calamities.

“Why is World Seal looking for him?” An overlord became afraid.

World Seal belonged to First Vine, a close ally of Life and Death Heaven. In theory, it shouldn’t be looking for Calamities.

“What is happening here?” Light God watched in a daze.

World Seal somehow found Calamities’ hidden location and caused tribulations to go wild.

“To replicate.” Li Qiye said.

***

“Why Calamities, because he’s unique?” An overlord said.

World Seal could replicate anything including the world. However, First Vine always had control over it.

“Li Xingchen’s creation water awakened World Seal and now, it considers Calamities to be the one worth replicating the most.” An overlord speculated.

Overlords and immortals realizing this had an awkward smile. World Seal ignored them and only went for Calamities, considering him superior. In truth, he was unique with all those tribulations.

“Crackle!” It became a contest between the endless heavenly dao and rampaging tribulations.

Despite the numerous layers, some bolts still pierced through. A remnant bolt of the fire affinity just happened to head for World City, capable of obliterating it.

Light God saw this and became alarmed.

“Go!” He, willingly or not, leaped into the air to meet it.

“Unrestrained Light!” He became gigantic and his light protected the city.

“Boom! Boom!” The bolt still pierced numerous holes in the barrier.

“High Heaven Dao Sigil!” He roared and raised both hands, turning the sigil into a gigantic shield.

Thunderous crackles resonated as the lightning bolt struck the seal. Each lightning strand was minuscule yet had the impact of a cosmic hammer, causing him to spew a mouthful of blood.

“Protect!” He shouted again and three supreme figures appeared behind him and granted him power.

“Light God!” Others shouted his title.

“He’s so strong, definitely eligible to become an overlord.” One primal ancestor said.

“The inheritor of the three immortals’ legacy.” Many prostrated to show respect ot the three figures.

His current power exceeded other primal ancestors at this moment. Although he dealt with only a single bolt, it could still kill any other primal ancestor.
